item.title: The Software Supply Chain Is Under Siege. Devs Are Still the First Line of Defense
item.description: 77% of organizations experienced a software supply chain incident in the past year. Today, Docker AI Governance now streams every policy decision in your organization into the SIEM your security... Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-ai-governance-audit-logs-now-where-your-security-team-already-works/

item.title: Empty sandboxes break developer experience
item.description: Learn how Docker Sandbox kits turn empty sandboxes into productive development environments with repeatable tooling, credentials, and configuration. Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/empty-sandboxes-break-developer-experience/

item.title: Docker OIDC connections for GitHub Actions available for Docker Orgs
item.description: Eliminate Stored Credentials in Your CI/CD Pipelines TL;DR: Docker now supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) for GitHub Actions. Your workflows can authenticate with short-lived, per-run tokens instead of stored PATs or OATs. No secrets to rotate, no credentials to leak. GitHub OIDC connections are available to organizations with Docker Team, Docker Business, or Docker Hardened Images... Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-oidc-connections-for-github-actions-available-for-docker-orgs/

item.title: The Future of Agentic AI Depends on Openness and Trust. That’s Why Docker Is Joining Nvidia’s Open Secure AI Alliance.
item.description: Docker joins NVIDIA's Open Secure AI Alliance to help build the security, governance, and trust frameworks that agentic AI systems demand. Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/docker-joins-nvidia-open-secure-ai-alliance/

item.title: Coding Agent Horror Stories: The 29 Million Secret Problem
item.description: Learn how AI coding agents can expose credentials in supply chain attacks and how Docker Sandboxes keep secrets out of an agent's reach. Link to article: https://www.docker.com/blog/coding-agent-horror-stories-the-29-million-secret-problem/
